items.headline: High Wind Warning issued November 8 at 8:56PM AKST until November 9 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Prince of Wales Island.

* WHEN...From 4 AM to 3 PM AKST Monday.

* IMPACTS...High winds will blow around unsecured objects, damage
property and cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Winds will strengthen overnight Sunday into
Monday. Strongest winds are expected to impact the gulf coast and
southern portions of the island Monday morning through the early
afternoon.
items.instruction:
Report any damage to the National Weather Service by visiting
weather.gov/Juneau/StormReports.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 8 at 8:45PM AKST until November 9 at 6:00PM AKST by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A strong system is expected to move through the area Sunday night
into Monday. Temperatures below freezing combined with snow levels
below 1,000 ft are indicative of snowfall for upper elevations.
Mid-level southeasterly flow suggests potential for White Pass to be
sheltered from much of the precipitation, but would allow for ample
moisture to make it into the Haines Borough, falling as snow at the
border. The winter storm watch will be upgraded to a winter storm
warning for the upper elevations
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. For the latest road
conditions where available call 511 or visit 511.alaska.gov.

items.instruction:

extremely poor visibilities. This can lead to whiteout conditions and
make travel very hazardous.
